definitions.explanation: Being absent from work, whether due to illness, personal reasons, or other circumstances.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}で{欠勤|けっきん}した。
examples.english: I was absent from work due to a cold.

examples.japanese: {無断|むだん}{欠勤|けっきん}は{厳禁|げんきん}です。
{今月|こんげつ}は{欠勤|けっきん}が{多|おお}くて{給料|きゅうりょう}が{減|へ}った。
examples.english: I had many absences this month, so my pay decreased.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{欠|けつ} (lack, absence) + {勤|きん} (work, service) - being absent from work duty.

USAGE:
Distinguished by type:
・{有給欠勤|ゆうきゅうけっきん} - paid absence
・{無断欠勤|むだんけっきん} - unexcused absence
・{病気欠勤|びょうきけっきん} - sick leave

COLLOCATIONS:
・{欠勤|けっきん}する - to be absent from work
・{欠勤届|けっきんとどけ} - absence notification
・{欠勤|けっきん}{日数|にっすう} - number of absent days

RELATED:
・{出勤|しゅっきん} - going to work (opposite)
・{勤怠|きんたい} - attendance record
